up: List all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5375941'. For each molecule, retrieve its ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary), preferred name, maximum development phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures, where available). Order the results by the molecule's ChEMBL identifier in ascending order.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5375941' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
